title: Verify, request the exact human action, then resume
when: A declared site is signed out or an exploratory mission hits auth
need: Verify first; authorize opens only expired sites. Human supplies personal credentials; unreachable probes need technical repair. Sign-in pauses automated browsers on that machine until windows close. From the connected workstation, --machine reads declarations and opens sign-in on the registered Test Machine GUI, without a control-plane connection there. Unrouted hosts still receive nonsecret declarations locally; live identity store survives reset. Required desktop-browser extension: browser authorize must also check Test Machine Linux Chromium and macOS Safari sign-ins, open only expired sites, name the account, and keep desktop sign-ins live through reset outside goldens. This extension remains unimplemented until an exact successor and source evidence are supplied; existing automation identity behavior is separate.
surface: Installed browser identities reference and authorize help; successor Pack Linux procedure and macOS entry pointer to the complete browser-identities procedure.
gap: The unreleased successor repairs the portable installed reference and per-OS private-policy audience boundary in source. Released-target and actual receiving/sign-in proof remain pending. The required desktop-browser authorization extension has no implementation evidence yet.
review: Remote command, lease ownership, settings validation, quoting, OS GUI helpers and post-window outcome forwarding have source regression tests; live operator sign-in proof remains pending. Source-only successor documentation preserves all six macOS identity steps in browser-identities.md and keeps a mandatory macOS entry link.
